title: One Scan is Enough: Demonstration-Free Adaptation for Language-Guided Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying a language-guided navigation policy in a new building usually means watching it fail. Public-benchmark VLAs degrade scene by scene as layout, appearance, and language drift, and the standard fix of teleoperating fresh trajectories on site does not scale. We replace human demonstration with a single brief iPhone scan. Scan2Instruction compiles that scan into a complete training environment, automatically synthesizing executable navigation episodes with grounded instructions. PRPT-KS then adapts the policy through a closed-form Pareto utility read directly off the reconstructed scene, with no learned critic and no human labels. Across five real environments, the two designs together drive our RealNav to an 85% real-robot success rate, compared with 49% for a RealNav baseline post-trained on human demonstrations, and still achieve 82% in unscanned regions of the same buildings, compared with 41% for the same baseline. translated_title: 一次扫描就够了：面向语言引导导航的无示教自适应
translated_abstract: 在新建筑中部署语言引导导航策略通常意味着眼看着它失败。公开基准上的视觉-语言-动作模型会随着布局、外观和语言的漂移而逐场景性能下降，而标准的解决方案——在现场遥操作采集全新轨迹——无法规模化。我们用一段简短的iPhone扫描替代人类示教。Scan2Instruction将该扫描编译成完整的训练环境，自动合成带有接地指令的可执行导航片段。PRPT-KS随后通过直接从重建场景中读取的闭式帕累托效用来适配策略，无需学习评论家模型，也无需人工标注。在五个真实环境中，这两项设计共同使我们的RealNav达到85%的真实机器人成功率，而基于人类示教后训练的RealNav基线仅为49%；且在同一建筑的未扫描区域仍达到82%，而相同基线仅为41%。我们的工作表...
tldr: 该论文提出用一次简短的iPhone扫描替代人工示教，通过Scan2Instruction自动合成完整训练环境并用PRPT-KS的闭式帕累托效用适配策略，使语言引导导航机器人在真实环境中达到85%的成功率（且在未扫描区域仍达82%），远超基于人类示教训练的49%基线。
